name: Atuatanga
summary:
Step into Atuatanga, an immersive virtual reality experience that transports you to the heart of a Māori worldview. The year is 3011, and Mother Earth, Papatūānuku has been decimated by mankind. Her bond with Ranginui, Skyfather, has been severed and their children, the Atua, are in hiding.
From the beginning of time, to the heart of Papatuanuku, from the tops of the mountains, to the first breath of life. Your actions will determine the future of humanity.
